Definition: from G40; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state):--holiness.
BiblicalUsage: The word hagiótēs carries the sense of holiness. In Hebrews 12:10, the text says "that [we] might be partakers of his holiness."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hagiótēs as it stands: holiness.
